column1: # Positive-control loci for AFSHF-TARGETMAP smoke tests.
# Source: well-established lead loci from the published AF / HF / stroke GWAS
# literature. Used as a sanity gate during harmonization and downstream QC:
#   - At least one variant per locus must survive harmonize() in cis window.
#   - In Phase 3 these genes should produce concordant MR signals on the
#     trait they were selected for (sign and rough magnitude as published).
# Coordinates are GRCh38 gene-body boundaries (Ensembl/HGNC); the cis window
# Approximate lead variant rsid is provided for fast manual lookup; the
# pipeline does NOT rely on that single SNP being present, only on the
# cis window containing at least one significant variant.
#   gene_symbol, chr, gene_start, gene_end, build, trait, role,
# expected_direction is the direction of the LEAD risk allele on the named
# trait (matches sign in the cited GWAS); '?' = direction not constrained.
